statement_nl: For every integer m >= 2 and every integer g >= 0, the number N(m, g) of numerical semigroups with multiplicity m and genus g satisfies N(m, g) <= N(m, g + 1).

domain_restrictions: m is an integer with m ≥ 2
g is an integer with g ≥ 0
g + 1 is therefore an integer with g + 1 ≥ 1 (so the genus parameter remains in the intended nonnegative-integer regime)
statement_semantic_sketch.normalized_claim: For all integers m ≥ 2 and g ≥ 0, letting N(m,g) be the number of numerical semigroups having multiplicity m and genus g, we have N(m,g) ≤ N(m,g+1).

variables.name: N(m,g)
variables.role: count of numerical semigroups with multiplicity m and genus g
